jobs.subject: Fumer WM-002 — edge cleanup
jobs.source_type: targeted cutout cleanup of generated trial, original reference retained for identity
jobs.prompt: Use case: targeted background cleanup and identity preservation. Image1 is the full-body left-facing Fumer candidate to edit. Image2 is its original RE7 Not a Hero Fumer reference, included only to distinguish genuine organic fibers from background artifacts. Keep the exact single character design, anatomy, pose, left-facing direction, proportions, texture colors, hands, feet and facial details of image1. Remove the broad flat grey-brown semi-transparent background patches behind the head and neck, along the back and outside the forearms; remove detached stray background pixels. Those flat matte patches are not parts of the creature. Retain the actual fine source-defined fungal threads and irregular body-edge fibers; do not erase them or flatten the creature into a smooth shape. Produce a clean transparent cutout with alpha zero in all empty regions, including between the arms and torso and between the legs. Preserve soft antialiasing only at true filament and silhouette edges, without a grey halo, tinted veil, paper-like fringe, matte border or cast shadow. Increase the empty canvas around the unchanged figure so its height occupies at most80 percent of the image height, leaving at least10 percent clear padding above its head and below its toes. Do not add limbs, clothing, anatomy, effects, a floor, background, text or another pose. One intact static creature only. This is a finishing correction of an existing accepted design, not a new design.
